fact: The 2023 civil registration yearbook, published November 2025, draws birth, marriage and death statistics for all 77 communes from the ANIP administrative database, as the 2020-34 law lets INStaD access the integrated civil registration system.
title: Annuaire des statistiques des faits d'état civil au Bénin (2023)
publisher: Institut National de la Statistique et de la Démographie (INStaD)
